9779a588c0720af345663fa28a77693641c7e7d8.headline: Lebanese army deploys heavily after major clash near Sagesse University in Furn El Chebbak
9779a588c0720af345663fa28a77693641c7e7d8.body: A major clash occurred around Sagesse University in Furn El Chebbak, followed by a heavy deployment of the Lebanese army.

fe8c0d789ada05f55a16ec27bb449fe7d369eadc.headline: Israeli media report interceptor missile launched in Upper Galilee

e28b3509f207799e36b185b26f9737a7f7970753.headline: Polling stations open for Israeli Knesset elections
e28b3509f207799e36b185b26f9737a7f7970753.body: Polling stations for the Israeli Knesset elections opened at seven o'clock in the morning local time in Jerusalem.

e2683a777e3ec813b733a73fe182d39a4d0acb21.headline: Ogero workers announce open-ended strike over pay and rights
e2683a777e3ec813b733a73fe182d39a4d0acb21.body: The Ogero Workers and Employees Union declared an open-ended strike on October 27 to demand protection of employee rights and payment of financial dues, with a crisis cell formed to handle urgent technical cases.

132371c7fea6cba4bd7d770644019f7b5abbe364.headline: Lebanese MP Ali Ammar says readiness is high, states Lebanon does not seek war but is prepared to confront Israel if necessary

58af3cd036c34e7d91a0a364960066a3dd7700f9.headline: Iranian Foreign Ministry warns of firm response to threats near its borders
58af3cd036c34e7d91a0a364960066a3dd7700f9.body: The Iranian Foreign Ministry stated that Iranian armed forces will act decisively if they perceive any threat to Iran's borders.

cbb73118b78460d2db0db79beb43ded92bfbdc85.headline: Fuel prices in Lebanon change: gasoline down, diesel and gas up
cbb73118b78460d2db0db79beb43ded92bfbdc85.body: On October 27, the price of 98-octane and 95-octane gasoline in Lebanon fell by 35,000 Lebanese pounds each, while diesel rose by 12,000 pounds and gas cylinders by 51,000 pounds. New prices: 95-octane gasoline at 2,651,000 pounds, 98-octane at 2,669,000 pounds, diesel at 2,576,000 pounds, and gas at 1,545,000 pounds.

cbb73118b78460d2db0db79beb43ded92bfbdc85.headline: US Republican Tom Harb says Israel likely to resume strikes on Hezbollah sites in Lebanon
cbb73118b78460d2db0db79beb43ded92bfbdc85.body: Tom Harb, a member of the US Republican Party, stated that Israel is expected to resume targeted strikes on Hezbollah centers and tunnels in Beirut's southern suburbs and the Bekaa, with possible US approval for expanded operations but no large-scale ground invasion.

a1932582e3d1bddc5efca2fdac22b63879b47586.headline: Israeli Defense Minister Katz says Israel faces two options: continue the offensive approach based on initiative and decisiveness, or return to a policy of containment and appeasement.

684732f9fa4d44907e5b3671c81edca274202f06.headline: Israeli broadcaster reports Israeli flights over Syria and Iraq to Iranian border led to IRGC threats against Israel
684732f9fa4d44907e5b3671c81edca274202f06.body: The Israeli broadcaster stated that Israeli sorties last week reaching the Iranian border prompted threats from Iran's Revolutionary Guard, which were recently conveyed to regional parties.

aebf9740bb7379ef0f364981d650e8a697dcbd94.headline: Foreign Minister Youssef Rajji says he is concerned Hezbollah is preparing for a new war at Iran's request

87e43f86f817e66c1c5d7bf902e311c4e825cf59.headline: Lebanese Army intelligence frees two kidnapped Syrian women in Hermel
87e43f86f817e66c1c5d7bf902e311c4e825cf59.body: The women were abducted about two weeks ago after being lured from Syria to Lebanon, with a ransom demanded from their families. Efforts to arrest those involved are ongoing.

c37bca43e439413522c74c602f556e507c4dfc59.headline: Israeli drone strike reported in the Jarmak area
c37bca43e439413522c74c602f556e507c4dfc59.body: An Israeli drone strike reportedly targeted the Jarmak area.

32ab31594ed18335a203a51b13d46000a8fe4ae6.headline: Large explosion reported near Bani Hayyan, southern Lebanon
Report: Netanyahu and election rival Eisenkot agree on continued Israeli occupation in Lebanon with security conditions and no set withdrawal date

bad932f2cf5ed439e768f7e00ca7ec83742aa2db.headline: Large explosion reportedly carried out by Israeli forces in Talouseh, southern Lebanon
bad932f2cf5ed439e768f7e00ca7ec83742aa2db.body: A large explosion reportedly carried out by Israel occurred in Talouseh, southern Lebanon.

5d74bf82e9a98e838edcc3273ada29c95d6193b5.headline: Israeli election results show no clear winner; estimates suggest Eisenkot may be tasked to form government
5d74bf82e9a98e838edcc3273ada29c95d6193b5.body: Initial results and exit polls indicate Netanyahu's bloc has 50 seats and Eisenkot's bloc 53, with no side reaching a majority. Channel 12 estimates the president will ask Eisenkot to form a government. Opposition leader Lapid claims Netanyahu's alliance suffered a major defeat.

4878eca8dac18e1bf1ce0ba56a8cb48f3c2de151.headline: Israeli Defense Minister Katz holds urgent consultations with Chief of Staff Zamir regarding Iran

ae260f60cc801f9e5d7f2240eb8e2b2885a7b6dc.headline: Heavy rains cause severe damage at Tel Chiha Hospital in Zahle, Bekaa
ae260f60cc801f9e5d7f2240eb8e2b2885a7b6dc.body: Flooding from heavy rainfall led to significant material damage at Tel Chiha Hospital in Zahle, Bekaa.

ae260f60cc801f9e5d7f2240eb8e2b2885a7b6dc.headline: Beirut restaurant and meat warehouse closed over food poisoning and health violations
ae260f60cc801f9e5d7f2240eb8e2b2885a7b6dc.body: Authorities sealed Nadini restaurant in central Beirut after food poisoning cases, and a meat warehouse in Raouche for health violations and suspected meat fraud.

7266572d8202fdcc97675a87cc8a55daeb85b980.headline: Unknown individuals vandalize Lebanese University campus in Zahle
7266572d8202fdcc97675a87cc8a55daeb85b980.body: Overnight, unidentified persons broke into the Faculty of Arts at Lebanese University’s fourth branch in Zahle, damaging several doors and windows.

8ddef501aa527bfe67cf1815340115fd6f856c30.headline: Qatari mediators present new draft deal to Iran; response expected by end of week
8ddef501aa527bfe67cf1815340115fd6f856c30.body: Reuters reports that Qatari mediators delivered a draft agreement to Iran in Tehran on Sunday. The proposal includes a seven-day timeline for both sides to address concerns with daily confidence-building steps, and several countries would act as guarantors. Iran is expected to respond by the end of the week.

85bf7343e45250fbcd21cdda755b71c0f2213688.headline: Lebanon expected to be affected by heavy rains and storms from Thursday
85bf7343e45250fbcd21cdda755b71c0f2213688.body: The Lebanese Meteorological Service forecasts that a weather front will bring heavy rain, thunderstorms, and strong winds up to 75 km/h, especially in the north, starting Thursday morning and lasting until Friday morning.

85bf7343e45250fbcd21cdda755b71c0f2213688.headline: Intensive drone activity reported over southern Lebanon and Beirut's southern suburbs at low altitude, attributed to Israel

9974f285f5a75aea4b591205cb887b8e31f1c8f7.headline: Lebanese police recover more than 80 thousand dollars in stolen goods in North Lebanon
9974f285f5a75aea4b591205cb887b8e31f1c8f7.body: The investigative unit in the North recovered stolen items worth more than 80 thousand dollars, including gold and mobile phones, in the area of al-Muhammara. The suspect, a Syrian national, was arrested within less than 24 hours after an operation in Minieh following his luring from Beirut.

9974f285f5a75aea4b591205cb887b8e31f1c8f7.headline: President Aoun reaffirms government decisions on exclusive authority over arms and war
9974f285f5a75aea4b591205cb887b8e31f1c8f7.body: President Aoun stated there will be no reversal of government decisions regarding exclusive control over weapons and decisions of war and peace, citing alignment with the constitution, Taif Agreement, and ministerial statement.

942c5ad8d36eeaa16ef0109439fdb02fcc384b1b.headline: US reportedly warns Iran time is running out to avoid military strike
942c5ad8d36eeaa16ef0109439fdb02fcc384b1b.body: Channel 12 Israel, citing diplomatic sources, reports that Washington told Iranian officials that time is running out to reach an agreement to prevent a US military strike, demanding Iran hand over highly enriched uranium, halt regional military operations, and open the Strait of Hormuz.

cc5a63f75ea93c8044fcd467fd1f300c4ff429fe.headline: Beirut municipality shuts down meat warehouse over food poisoning investigation
cc5a63f75ea93c8044fcd467fd1f300c4ff429fe.body: Beirut's municipality closed the 'Rihamco' meat warehouse in Raouche by order of Governor Marwan Abboud, following an investigation into food poisoning cases. Inspectors found the warehouse operating without a license and violating health regulations, with suspicions of meat mixing and supplying restaurants.

66b06c0670f98ac3dd67a63e55fe889c8993b936.headline: Hezbollah's deputy leader to deliver statement on Lebanese and regional political developments
66b06c0670f98ac3dd67a63e55fe889c8993b936.body: Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem is scheduled to give a statement today, Wednesday, at 6:00 p.m. addressing political developments in Lebanon and the region.

e9588eba1ad302bf0f18f8dbbfd6cbba1ec31360.headline: Lebanese spice product withdrawn in Germany over high pesticide residue
e9588eba1ad302bf0f18f8dbbfd6cbba1ec31360.body: The Abido (sumac) spice, produced in Lebanon, has been pulled from German markets after tests found high concentrations of pesticide residue.

e9588eba1ad302bf0f18f8dbbfd6cbba1ec31360.headline: Lawyer arrested in Beirut for forging judicial notice and impersonating judges
e9588eba1ad302bf0f18f8dbbfd6cbba1ec31360.body: A lawyer in Beirut was detained after admitting to forging a judicial notice, signing it in the names of the court president and registrar, and impersonating several judges.

20c36b64ba772ede0178980976c7e415f306c0d7.headline: Explosion reported near the town of Kounine in southern Lebanon
Unidentified drone explodes in Wadi Zibqin area after extended flight over Hanine and Mansouri
Hezbollah's deputy leader reiterates commitment to armed resistance and rejects disarmament
20c36b64ba772ede0178980976c7e415f306c0d7.body: Sheikh Naim Qassem stated that Hezbollah will continue its resistance in Lebanon, will not discuss disarmament, and criticized U.S. influence over parts of the Lebanese state.

d53ff7b22085e8c1a8ffb3556d453990a50e0467.headline: Iranian foreign minister says armed forces are ready to defend the nation and diplomacy is ongoing
d53ff7b22085e8c1a8ffb3556d453990a50e0467.body: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said the armed forces are ready to defend the nation, and Iran continues to give diplomacy a chance to succeed, with ongoing close communication with mediators to review ideas ensuring implementation of their seven-day plan in less than a week.

4e0ed10166b8f52405161bcf2749bd50eebb3674.headline: Beirut airport operating on backup generators due to power outage
4e0ed10166b8f52405161bcf2749bd50eebb3674.body: Rafic Hariri International Airport has been without electricity from the public grid since the morning of October 28, 2026, relying on backup generators. The airport administration has urged Electricité du Liban to urgently restore power and clarify the cause of the outage.

efe69d9bd92c9842cf33b33be6be69fd64da4bae.headline: Lebanon's secondary school teachers announce three-day strike and warn of further escalation
efe69d9bd92c9842cf33b33be6be69fd64da4bae.body: The Secondary Education Association declared a strike for Thursday, Friday, and Saturday in all public secondary schools and warned of possible further escalation.

a494dc94248d85dc43ac93064f4c99f0d0a8f7b9.headline: Axios: U.S. attack on Iran likely after midterm elections if no agreement is reached
a494dc94248d85dc43ac93064f4c99f0d0a8f7b9.body: Axios, citing U.S. and Israeli officials, reported that a planned operation could target Iranian leadership, energy, and facilities, with a week of intensive strikes possible. Israeli and U.S. military leaders have discussed preparations.

973efb117bc373e42393df5c053b535931413db9.headline: Diplomatic sources: Lebanon warned of severe Israeli response if Hezbollah enters war
973efb117bc373e42393df5c053b535931413db9.body: Diplomatic sources told Al Jadeed that Lebanon has received serious warnings that any Hezbollah involvement in the conflict would be met with a very strong Israeli response.

66c71c87a3498c8cd4e017338d73e190ff01e422.headline: Israeli airstrike reported on Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon
Israeli intelligence aircraft reportedly conduct extensive surveillance over southern Lebanon, Beirut, and Damascus
66c71c87a3498c8cd4e017338d73e190ff01e422.body: Three Israeli AWACS aircraft reportedly carried out reconnaissance, target updating, communications interception, and jamming operations over the area from Mount Hermon in Syria to Naqoura, including Beirut and Damascus.

ddce6585c98dbdf2b3feeca8f218085e942dda32.headline: Israeli raids reported on Barashit, Wadi al-Hujayr, and Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon

281ad6a57295c498b31cc1c60b530d6ae9a1b7ba.headline: Israeli army says it launched interceptor missile at suspected aerial target over southern Lebanon
281ad6a57295c498b31cc1c60b530d6ae9a1b7ba.body: The Israeli military stated it fired an interceptor missile at a suspicious aerial target detected in its area of operations in southern Lebanon. No sirens were activated.

2686144a25c1ddde280f8dfac16ae73bf13716a7.headline: Lebanon: Meeting set for Friday to discuss minimum wage increase
2686144a25c1ddde280f8dfac16ae73bf13716a7.body: A meeting between economic bodies, the General Labor Union, and the Minister of Labor is scheduled for Friday to discuss raising Lebanon's minimum wage. Employers reportedly propose around $400, while the union demands over $1,100. A relevant official stated the new minimum wage will be approved before year-end.

2686144a25c1ddde280f8dfac16ae73bf13716a7.headline: Israeli artillery targets Wadi al-Hujayr, outskirts of al-Qantara and Mevdoun in southern Lebanon
Israeli vehicles move between Zotar al-Sharqiya and Zotar al-Gharbiya with machine gun sweeping

81b2bb670c3050f02c579623389d84e4c3b082af.headline: Israeli broadcaster: Israel seeks Trump's approval for possible strike on Iranian energy facilities
81b2bb670c3050f02c579623389d84e4c3b082af.body: Israeli broadcaster says Israel wants to obtain Trump's approval and green light to strike Iranian energy facilities.

8eb82b0ae3f8bcce9bff3733f9cce1823c7b9f79.headline: Lebanon's Ministry of Finance: Public sector and military salaries, pensions transferred to banks
8eb82b0ae3f8bcce9bff3733f9cce1823c7b9f79.body: The Ministry of Finance announced that salaries for public sector employees, military personnel, and pensions for retirees have been transferred to the Central Bank and are now available to beneficiaries through their banks.

91e46564f9154413a522be7d28b6a5f79d0f8323.headline: Report: Trump pledged to guarantee full Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon if Lebanon joins Abraham Accords
91e46564f9154413a522be7d28b6a5f79d0f8323.body: According to a senior Gulf diplomatic source cited by Al-Diyar, this pledge is contingent on broader U.S.-Iran understandings.

8f8366f45bac6f7205ee6b30d8ca13ccb14726fe.headline: President Aoun calls for halt to Israeli attacks and progress on ceasefire, withdrawal, border demarcation, and detainee issues
8f8366f45bac6f7205ee6b30d8ca13ccb14726fe.body: President Aoun stated that ongoing Israeli military operations and targeting of civilian areas and infrastructure are worsening the suffering of residents and undermining stability efforts. He said Lebanon has raised four main issues in negotiations—ceasefire, Israeli withdrawal, border demarcation, and detainees—but no significant progress has been made. Aoun added that the Lebanese state and army are ready to address security concerns through official mechanisms rather than military action.

80600bd413b9b859131bef258d77214a90293dd4.headline: Flooding hits Zahle and northern Bekaa, homes inundated and residents call for help
80600bd413b9b859131bef258d77214a90293dd4.body: Heavy rains caused floods in Zahle and the highlands of Baalbek, Arsal, and Ras Baalbek, with several homes flooded and residents seeking assistance.

80600bd413b9b859131bef258d77214a90293dd4.headline: Israeli forces reportedly set fire to homes in Zoutr al-Sharqiya, southern Lebanon
Priest Samir Daou found killed in his home in Ain Jrein

06710a76b8a854daee16a000f3b36b44b74533cf.headline: Israeli minister reportedly calls for settlements in southern Lebanon and Gaza
06710a76b8a854daee16a000f3b36b44b74533cf.body: Bezalel Smotrich was reported celebrating Israeli election results and urging the formation of a government, calling for a harsh military operation by the Israeli army, crushing West Bank villages, and establishing settlements in southern Lebanon and Gaza.

30a44f29cc1d8f31abda81b180ddc9a35826730e.headline: Lebanese security forces seize weapons and explosives in Tripoli raid
30a44f29cc1d8f31abda81b180ddc9a35826730e.body: Lebanon's General Security raided a home in Abi Samra, Tripoli, seizing weapons, explosives, detonators, and C4. The suspect, identified as R. S., is reportedly linked to ISIS, and several individuals were detained.

cfb53b39a010f32aea9551c693a1b4d286d4f4ed.headline: Imad Jomaa, ISIS leader detained in Lebanon since 2014, reportedly transferred to Homs prison and released by Syrian government
cfb53b39a010f32aea9551c693a1b4d286d4f4ed.body: According to Lebanon News, Imad Jomaa, known as Abu Ahmad al-Qusayr and founder of Liwa Fajr al-Islam, was released by the Syrian government after being moved from Roumieh prison in Lebanon to Homs central prison.

112bcb416a9f8ee5c29b6d6bdd4c259be84228ca.headline: Israeli intelligence aircraft reportedly conduct surveillance flights with upgraded radar and sensors
112bcb416a9f8ee5c29b6d6bdd4c259be84228ca.body: Israeli Nachshon Oron 452 aircraft are reported to be carrying out intelligence flights, equipped with new GMTI and AESA radar technologies for high-resolution ground mapping and target detection, as well as advanced electro-optical and infrared sensors.

9f17cfc16cba6a0a8a3c271caac852e5e1ba5b56.headline: Iran reportedly insists on U.S. meeting seven conditions; no response yet to U.S. vice president's message
9f17cfc16cba6a0a8a3c271caac852e5e1ba5b56.body: Tasnim, citing Iranian sources, reports that Iran has not responded to a message from the U.S. vice president to the secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, and that Iran insists Washington must meet seven conditions and rejects any deviation.

9a7749f64a8201cd981c99a13c2fbb8a135e0b8d.headline: Shooting reported at LMC Hospital in Hadath; injuries possible
9a7749f64a8201cd981c99a13c2fbb8a135e0b8d.body: Preliminary reports indicate a dispute at LMC Hospital in Hadath involved gunfire, with information suggesting there may be injuries.

54901d46f5e67bd65cc0c9e8daa146fc47fcc67d.headline: Hezbollah reportedly has not conveyed a firm stance to Speaker Berri on intervention in any battle
54901d46f5e67bd65cc0c9e8daa146fc47fcc67d.body: Al Jadeed reports that Hezbollah sources say all media reports on its combat readiness are inaccurate, and that Lebanon took a wide space in discussions during international meetings in Tehran and Moscow, which reportedly reassured the Shiite duo.

699b7fc07c603cfa155b32cb51973ab1b695a3a1.headline: Israeli security apparatus reportedly preparing for possible Trump decision on military campaign against Iran

4fa8d1cc42aecfc45130b9a5490b49275d5ab61b.headline: Israeli broadcaster: At least ten U.S. military cargo planes landed in Israel during the last 24 hours

4702c85adfd7bb10d73866a28cd44e198ae8d23c.headline: Flooding reported on roads in Bab al-Raml, Tripoli due to heavy rain
Israeli surveillance aircraft reportedly flew for hours off southern Lebanon's coast
4702c85adfd7bb10d73866a28cd44e198ae8d23c.body: A Gulfstream G280 equipped for electronic intelligence was reported to have conducted prolonged flights near Lebanon's southern coast.

a1bd723759c237632481d2a73bb826b0591e9c4e.headline: Iran reportedly activates air defenses over Qeshm Island
a1bd723759c237632481d2a73bb826b0591e9c4e.body: A Telegram channel reports activation of Iranian air defenses over Qeshm Island.

5905beb03e03e9bd2539f40d4484317b07858f15.headline: Arrest warrants issued for former Economy Minister Amin Salam, his brother, and an auditor in Beirut
5905beb03e03e9bd2539f40d4484317b07858f15.body: The Beirut Indictment Chamber, chaired by Judge Kamal Nassar, has referred the case of former Economy Minister Amin Salam and his brother Karim Salam to the Criminal Court and issued arrest warrants for them and auditor Elie Aboud.

5905beb03e03e9bd2539f40d4484317b07858f15.headline: Interceptors reportedly launched over southern Lebanon after suspicious aerial activity
5905beb03e03e9bd2539f40d4484317b07858f15.body: A rocket was reportedly launched at a suspicious aerial target near forces in southern Lebanon, followed by the explosion of two interceptor missiles over the towns of Taybeh and Deir Siriane.

d6c8b67cd23c3d2ff1356e9117a88e66cb1ab748.headline: Lebanon reportedly rejects US proposal for joint patrols with Israel after UNIFIL withdrawal
d6c8b67cd23c3d2ff1356e9117a88e66cb1ab748.body: According to Al-Diyar citing informed sources, Washington has proposed new security arrangements involving joint patrols between the Lebanese and Israeli armies along the 'yellow line' after a UNIFIL withdrawal. The Lebanese Army command reportedly rejected the proposal, insisting on a third-party presence to verify commitments, amid concerns about entrenching Israeli occupation and making temporary measures permanent.

d6c8b67cd23c3d2ff1356e9117a88e66cb1ab748.headline: Collapse of part of the mountain adjacent to the Al-Haykaliyah road towards Dahr Al-Ain due to rain

33d12e2448689fb19409ba45054a8170b2b9b102.headline: Charges to be filed against more than 7 suspects in explosives case in Lebanon
33d12e2448689fb19409ba45054a8170b2b9b102.body: According to a source cited by Al-Joumhouria, indictments in the explosives case are expected after noon on October 30, with over seven individuals implicated so far.

d4e96f04d088f69a4c958c4a4cb10bd44b268f9f.headline: Israeli artillery targets Al-Mansouri in Lebanon
Fuel prices in Lebanon change: gasoline down, diesel up, gas unchanged
d4e96f04d088f69a4c958c4a4cb10bd44b268f9f.body: The price of 95-octane and 98-octane gasoline in Lebanon fell by 40,000 Lebanese pounds each, diesel rose by 32,000 pounds, and the gas price was unchanged at 1,545,000 pounds.

8919f313dd0b37810c1db630ab411a849896463e.headline: Foreign correspondents reportedly arrive in Lebanon amid fears of possible regional war
8919f313dd0b37810c1db630ab411a849896463e.body: Lebanon News reports that dozens of foreign journalists have arrived in Lebanon due to concerns about a potential escalation that could affect the country.

8919f313dd0b37810c1db630ab411a849896463e.headline: Senior party figure in Lebanon warns of 'red lines' and increased readiness
8919f313dd0b37810c1db630ab411a849896463e.body: Party official Ghaleb Abu Zeinab stated that 'red lines' cannot be crossed, the era of Joseph Aoun is over, and that measures have been raised in anticipation.

9817107eee7388ca7ddbe1dc74c6c97c3fe578e3.headline: Lebanon's Health Ministry warns of suspected trichinellosis cases
9817107eee7388ca7ddbe1dc74c6c97c3fe578e3.body: The Ministry of Health has warned of suspected cases of trichinellosis, a parasitic disease transmitted through raw or undercooked meat, and urged the public to buy meat only from trusted, inspected sources.

9817107eee7388ca7ddbe1dc74c6c97c3fe578e3.headline: US ambassador accuses Berri and army chief of obstructing US efforts in Lebanon
9817107eee7388ca7ddbe1dc74c6c97c3fe578e3.body: US Ambassador Michel Issa reportedly accused Speaker Nabih Berri and Army Commander Rodolphe Haykal of hindering the American track in Lebanon and warned of expected changes in the coming weeks.

790c8bed5aee846a3379c4c340858d9c3777abff.headline: Brent crude price rises to $117 per barrel
Israeli media report signs of US preparing for major new attack on Iran

3b63f49bfbb702880845e4b11ff87275dc24ccf5.headline: Stray dog attacks reported in Baalbek amid lack of municipal response
3b63f49bfbb702880845e4b11ff87275dc24ccf5.body: Stray dogs have reportedly been attacking pedestrians in Baalbek, with sources criticizing the municipality and governor for failing to intervene.

42accb25780510dcd3a6003a41a65f6d7e8cb7b6.headline: Lebanese judiciary indicts 13 Hezbollah members in explosives case
42accb25780510dcd3a6003a41a65f6d7e8cb7b6.body: The indictments include charges of attacking state security, with five of the accused identified only by aliases.

42accb25780510dcd3a6003a41a65f6d7e8cb7b6.headline: Eight indicted in Dahr al-Baydar explosives case, including Haitham Amhaz and his wife
42accb25780510dcd3a6003a41a65f6d7e8cb7b6.body: Charges include belonging to armed groups without state consent and transporting large quantities of explosives from Baalbek to Beirut to undermine state authority and endanger Lebanon's security.

0bad934a68beff328a18981e7e9cc2f11681ec0f.headline: MP Hussein Hajj Hassan criticizes indictments against Lebanese citizens in explosives case
0bad934a68beff328a18981e7e9cc2f11681ec0f.body: On October 30, MP Hussein Hajj Hassan stated that the indictments against several Lebanese citizens lack basic national and human rights standards, arguing that the detainees were fulfilling a national duty defending Lebanon and should be honored, not prosecuted.

0b8b1781d92f3a8c8fa287b6a772f2a3ab0ed55d.headline: Electricité du Liban to cut power to public institutions in arrears, including Beirut airport, from November 2
0b8b1781d92f3a8c8fa287b6a772f2a3ab0ed55d.body: Electricité du Liban announced it will disconnect electricity to government departments and public institutions that have not paid their dues, starting the morning of November 2, except for public hospitals. Beirut airport is among those affected, with the Civil Aviation Directorate reportedly owing $22.8 million. Efforts are underway to resolve the issue.

5541bdca42df2ef973da68ce638c3a0cd869e57f.headline: Widespread GPS jamming reported in Lebanon and neighboring countries
5541bdca42df2ef973da68ce638c3a0cd869e57f.body: Widespread GPS jamming was reported on October 30 in Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, and parts of Jordan, Kuwait, the UAE, Qatar, and Turkey, according to a social media monitoring account.
